source_snapshot.test_name_items: Upgrade / Downgrade BMC firmware by Web when system is off
source_snapshot.procedure:
【Before Test】
    1. Check that the SUT configuration (e.g., hardware, firmware, drivers, etc.) matches the specifications/recipe definition.
    2. Clear logs (e.g., dmesg, syslog, SEL, etc.).

    【During Test】
    Upgrade / Downgrade BMC firmware through web UI.

    【After Test】
    1. Collect test results and photos, and save them to specific folders.
    2. Check if there are unexpected logs (e.g., dmesg, syslog, SEL, etc.) generate after test.
source_snapshot.criteria: Firmware should be flashed successfully after BMC reset only one time.

deepseek_columns.ai_packages_needed: browser/automation to drive the BMC web-UI flash page + BMC image (user provides)
deepseek_columns.ai_commands: -- BMC upgrade/downgrade via the BMC web UI: the agent first places the exact user-provided BMC image where the web-UIs upload control expects it, then drives the BMC flash page (upload image, start update, wait for completion) with host must be powered off first; after completion verify the BMC version. Interactive web-UI upload is not a single sshpass one-liner; walk the UI steps after the image is in place.
deepseek_columns.ai_logs_output: return screenshots + the flash-completion status and the BMC version shown before/after so the user confirms a successful flash and a clean single reset.
deepseek_columns.risk: RISK: BMC firmware flash via web UI is state-changing and can brick the BMC/host if interrupted; flash only the user-specified image and do not interrupt mid-flash.

original_test_intent: Perform approved BMC firmware upgrade and downgrade through the BMC WebUI while the host is in the project-defined off state, allowing one BMC reset per transition and verifying management and host recovery.
original_method: A human powers the host to the required off state while retaining BMC standby power, selects and commits each BMC image in WebUI, observes completion/reset, then verifies BMC version, reachability, logs and subsequent host boot.
manual_activity: The source's WebUI image selection, confirmation and progress/reset observation are manual core acceptance; an engineer also establishes host-off without removing required BMC standby power.
required_inputs: Exact BMC model/version transition matrix and signed image hashes
Definition and evidence of host-off versus BMC-powered state
Known-good recovery image, alternate console/programming path and acceptance criteria
safety_requirements: Distinguish host off from AC removal; the BMC must retain the power and network path required for WebUI update.
Use one approved image and one unchanged reset plan per transition; never retry or add resets after uncertainty.
Preserve pre-existing SEL/configuration evidence and capture any update-induced loss of management.
Stop if image compatibility, standby power, reset completion or BMC reachability becomes uncertain.
agent_execution_scope: Prepare immutable image/version evidence, read-only BMC baseline and log capture; monitor reachability and collect post-reset inventory plus host power-on health under the approved plan.
Do not operate or claim completion of the manual WebUI core and do not issue the engineer verdict.
engineer_actions: Approve/perform each WebUI transition and confirm the exact host-off/standby and single-reset sequence.
Assess BMC configuration, manageability, host recovery and final upgrade/downgrade verdicts.

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: It preserves host-off and version verification but browser automation cannot replace manual WebUI acceptance. Its clean-reset phrasing must be bound to the source's one-BMC-reset count, not interpreted as an AC cycle.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Use the vendor WebUI manually; use the existing read-only IPMI version script only after BMC reachability returns and its platform mapping is validated.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: The host-off condition, WebUI method, one BMC reset, script and 5/15-minute values remain.

modernized_recommendation.status: ATTENDED HOST-OFF BMC WEB UPDATE WITH RESET ACCOUNTING
modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Prove host S5/off while BMC standby remains stable, bind the WebUI selection to a signed image, capture the automatic or approved BMC reset as the single allowed reset, and independently verify active version, configuration, SEL, management reachability and subsequent host boot.
modernized_recommendation.applicable_platform: BMC platforms whose vendor procedure supports WebUI update with host off and BMC powered.
modernized_recommendation.supported_version: Record BMC hardware/firmware, WebUI/browser, IPMI tool/script and image versions.
modernized_recommendation.official_reference: Vendor BMC WebUI update, reset, configuration-preservation and recovery documentation.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Adds explicit S5-versus-AC state, reset accounting, independent reachability/configuration checks and recovery gates.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: Verifies the active BMC and restored management/host lifecycle, not only a browser completion message.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: Some BMC updates reset networking or configuration; expected transient loss and preservation scope must be project-defined.

project_override_considerations: Projects may define images, transition order, whether reset is automatically initiated, and host-off evidence. Completion applies only to that plan and cannot claim an AC-removed condition or extra transitions.
expected_evidence: Approved BMC transition matrix, signatures/hashes and compatibility
Host-off with stable BMC standby/reachability baseline
Manual WebUI selection, confirmation, progress, terminal status and exact reset timeline
Post-reset BMC active version/configuration/health/SEL and network recovery

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: The source consistently specifies BMC WebUI update with the system off and one BMC reset. Exact reset initiator/timing, versions and recovery are project readiness inputs; system off is interpreted as host off with BMC standby, not silently as AC removal.

blocked_analysis.analysis: The target, manual operation, host state and reset count are understandable. V3.1 does not make missing project details a permanent block; the WebUI core makes the case MANUAL ONLY.

comparison_to_prior_reviews.deepseek: Keeps host-off and BMC version scope while rejecting browser substitution for manual WebUI acceptance.
comparison_to_prior_reviews.gpt_v2: Retains destructive safeguards but changes BLOCKED to MANUAL ONLY because the remaining values can be supplied by an approved project plan.
comparison_to_prior_reviews.v3_1_improvement: Separates host-off readiness and engineer verdict from automation capability and avoids inventing AC removal.

review_improvement: Defines the critical distinction between host-off and BMC-unpowered state and makes the single reset auditable without changing the source.
independent_technical_reasoning: A BMC remains serviceable on standby power while the host is off, so the source describes a coherent attended workflow. Project-specific image and reset details are necessary before execution but do not make the intent ambiguous; manual WebUI control determines classification.
